scoring.method: score = 50 x share of milestones done (in-progress counts half) + 30 x mean KPI progress to target (capped at 1) + 20 x momentum (actions done since last review / actions planned, 0.5 when no prior review) - 5 per open blocker that only the Executive can clear (max -15). RAG: 60+ GREEN, 30-59 AMBER, under 30 RED.

objectives.title: Launch the Llandough guided tour (Wales)
objectives.owner_role: Programme Office (agent) delivers; Executive approves prices, dates and the guide
objectives.summary: Turn the nine-stop tour on /wales/ into tours people can book and walk: a walkable Llandough loop first, audio for every stop, a free booking path, partners and a pilot walk.

milestones.t: Nine-stop route and stop texts published in three languages
Gift-voucher pre-orders live (£25 / £45 / £90)
Walkable Llandough loop (stops 1, 2, 3, 8, 9) timed, mapped and access-checked; drive/bus legs for stops 4-7
Audio guide for all nine stops (English and Welsh) on /wales/
Free date-based booking path that also redeems vouchers
Partner pitch pack and 3-5 company conversations opened
Pilot walk with 8-12 guests and the first 5 written reviews
Public launch with dated tours and listings

next_actions: Record the nine stop texts as audio (English first) and add a player to each stop
Prepare the partner pitch pack and drafts for the shortlisted companies (held for GO)
Write a one-line promise for the tour and two test versions for the Wales page (proposal to the Wales section)

blockers.t: Who guides the pilot (a family guide or a qualified tour guide) and the insurance cover
Voucher codes are issued by hand until a payment-check key and a transactional email key are set
Tour prices and the first public dates

objectives.title: The evidence chronology
objectives.owner_role: Intelligence and research flywheels deliver; Programme Office tracks
objectives.summary: One cited chronology from 1667 to today, every entry linked to a record, with a register of records that should exist but have not been produced.

milestones.t: Chronology rule applied site-wide (1824 survey is the first record naming the house)
Catalogue of artifacts and citations searchable in one database
Missing-records register with catalogue IDs (MR-####)
Pending subject-access and information replies received and catalogued
Normalised events table and repeatable analyses published

next_actions: Catalogue every reply that arrives before each deadline
Re-run the interval and sequence analyses on the new events table

blockers.t: A password-protected police disclosure file cannot be opened

plan_log.action: Two-parcel reading tested (A: house parcel, B: top fields). Next: publish the test with what cuts against; records to seek: the 1955 Order 14 sealed order and affidavit with plan, the 1916 tenancy plan, all pages of DBDT/123/7 (archive read is an Executive decision).

Mountjoy Ltd as the 1938 grantor; the company existed by 1923. Next: publish on the title chain; catalogue DBDT53/2 (proposed EV-0659) and DBDT/124/4 (proposed EV-0660, Llanharan); await the 1938 deed replies (HM Land Registry, Cardiff Council, Glamorgan Archives).

Alfred Thomas, Lord Pontypridd, died 14 Dec 1927. Next: add the 1927-28 rows; catalogue the 1928 probate calendar entry (proposed EV-0681); clear a non-standard status label from the live EV-0284 page.
The 1961 deed, woodland A1 and the Leckwith Woods gift of 1940-42. Next: publish on the woodland page; catalogue South Wales Echo, 7 Nov 1994 (proposed EV-0662); seek a copy of the 1961 deed.
Directories of 1865-66 name Bute as owner of the soil (cuts against). Next: add the Webster 1865 and Harrod 1866 rows to EV-0225 and the cuts-against line on the title chain; open the page images.
The Times law report, 13 Aug 1987. Next: catalogue as proposed EV-0661; add to the press archive transcripts; open the page image to confirm the OCR readings.

How the textbooks report the case. Next: add a "How the case is taught" section; catalogue the eight texts (proposed EV-0671 to EV-0678) and the two case notes (proposed EV-0679, EV-0680); try to read [1994] Conv 196.

Hurst and Jones half-shares; the release to Bute of 11 Jan 1793. Next: correct any "chief rents only" reading of 1793; catalogue items 82-83 and the 1800, 1813 and 1817 DART/W items (proposed EV-0648 to EV-0652); the 1793 schedule is the next record to read (archive visit, an Executive decision).
Directory lines 1865-1914 for John Williams at Great House. Next: add the 1865, 1866 and 1914 rows to EV-0225 (1868, 1875 and 1880 are already there); check the 1914 column against the page image.

Leckwith manorial rents, 1935 (Bute estate file). Next: catalogue DB/M/14-19/16 (proposed EV-0653) and DB/M/10-13 as a negative screen (proposed EV-0654); reading the file is an archive visit (Executive decision).
1923: Bute land beside the Llandough Hospital site. Next: catalogue the Building item (proposed EV-0663); then the Guardians' minutes and the conveyance plan (catalogue search only).
